title: Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training
summary: A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.
body: A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.
summaryZh: OpenAI公布了一项涉及千余名学生的随机对照研究，评估了在真实大学作业中使用ChatGPT对学生批判性思维能力、原创性以及总体学业表现的综合影响，为大模型在教育领域的应用提供了实证数据。原始信息显示：A randomized study of more than 1,000 students examines ChatGPT, critical thinking, originality, and student performance on a real-world university assignment.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Better answers, broader thinking: What students gain from ChatGPT and critical-thinking training”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI发布了一项针对1000多名学生的随机研究，探讨ChatGPT在大学作业中对学生批判性思维和表现的影响。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
